test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. **

India has always believe in the value of the family system.
solution:
The correct answer is **'always believe in.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we read the sentence, we get to know the following things:
 
• The sentence is in **the present perfect tense.**
 
• In the present perfect tense, we normally use "**has/have + verb 3rd form."**
 
• The third form of the word **'believe'** is **'believed'**.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is ​Option 2.

 

**So, the sentence would be - ***India **has always believed** in the value of the family system.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the concept with some more examples:

 
 
• The employees of our company **have adjusted **themselves according to the situation.
 
• A student **has understood** the importance of online education during the pandemic.
